evidence.computation: An unsupported single-order request leaves the complete kernel session state unchanged. A recognized order binds one exact positive integral quantity to one complete known item phrase; confirmation still requires the pending proposal in the same session. Individual and zone sensor values use a latest timestamp no later than the supplied site clock, within the freshness window, and agreed by every supplied row at that timestamp.
assumptions: The fetched item-name table is accurate; a normalized complete name identifies one supplied item.
Each state file has one serialized owner; external file isolation is not proved.
The site clock, freshness bound and supplied sensor rows are accurate; finite agreement does not establish omitted-row coverage.
untrusted: English interpretation, exact numeric token recognition, item-table completeness, persistence and dispatch ownership.
